description: Type the 409 POST /databases answers for a duplicate database name as DatabaseAlreadyExists. The spec documents a 409 on the operation but only as the shared `handler.ErrorResponse` envelope; HydraDB's agent guide (https://docs.hydradb.com/AGENTS.md, section 12) lists DATABASE_ALREADY_EXISTS as 'duplicate database ID' and 409 as 'conflict, e.g. existing database'. Matched on `error.code`. No live response was recorded (no API key yet).

traits.smithy.api#documentation: A database with this name already exists (HydraDB DATABASE_ALREADY_EXISTS, HTTP 409).
